title: Prefabricated wood I-joists.
officialText: Structural capacities and design provisions for prefabricated wood I-joists shall be established and monitored in accordance with ASTM D 5055. The use of prefabricated wood I-joists structurally shall be subject to the special inspection requirements of Chapter 17.
